results.title: INTRO
SECTION-ADMIN
Viewer has read-only access
results.expected: Every switch disabled; no New flag, rule editing, edit, delete or API keys; notes say why
notes: 6/6 switches disabled; read-only notes shown; no Add rule, Save, Edit description, Delete or API keys.

results.title: Flag list explains the effective production audience
results.expected: Each row: Live/Partial/Off in prod + who gets it, in plain English
notes: new-dashboard: Partial, 'On for users u_102 and u_207, customer acme and 10% of users'; beta-reports: Partial, 'On for customer acme'; dark-mode: Off, 'Off for everyone'.

results.title: Production toggle requires confirmation and explains impact
results.expected: A dialog says who is affected before anything changes; Cancel changes nothing
notes: Dialog text before any change: 'Real users start getting it right away: 25% of users.'; server still OFF while asking; Cancel kept it OFF; Confirm turned it ON; the off-dialog warned 'Everyone in prod loses this feature right away.'

results.title: Rules can be edited, validated and saved
results.expected: A malformed ID is blocked with a message; a valid ID saves; the server has it
notes: 'Fix "bad#id" first…' shown and Save disabled; after Discard and Save, server rule 1 = u_102, u_207, u_501.

results.title: Activity search finds changes across all flag history
results.expected: Searching "rollout" lists every matching change, highlighted, (all matches)

results.title: A new MCP API-key token is shown only once
results.expected: Token and client config shown once (blurred here); gone after reload
notes: Token panel 'Copy this key now. It won't be shown again.' after create; after reload the key is listed and the token appears nowhere in the page.

results.title: SECTION-DEMO
Ana demonstrates direct user targeting
results.expected: new-dashboard ON via rule 1 (user ID list); beta-reports OFF
notes: Storefront: 'Welcome back, Ana' (new dashboard), no beta report. Debug: new-dashboard ON 'matched rule 1 (user ID list)'; beta-reports OFF 'no rule matched → Otherwise OFF'.

results.title: Cy demonstrates customer targeting
results.expected: new-dashboard ON via rule 2 (customer list); beta-reports ON for acme
notes: Debug: new-dashboard ON 'matched rule 2 (customer list)'; beta-reports ON 'matched rule 1 (customer list)'; storefront shows 'Spending by category for acme'.

results.title: Dee demonstrates deterministic percentage rollout
results.expected: ON via rule 3 (% rollout), the same on every load and every call
notes: ON 'matched rule 3 (% rollout)' on first load and after 2 reloads; 50/50 API evaluations ON via rule index 2. murmur3('new-dashboard:u_303') mod 10000 = 628, inside the first 10% (< 1000).

results.title: Eli demonstrates the Otherwise OFF path
results.expected: No rule matches: classic home; every flag OFF with "Otherwise OFF"
notes: Classic home 'Welcome to Corner Shop'; new-dashboard and beta-reports OFF 'no rule matched → Otherwise OFF'; dark-mode OFF 'flag is OFF in prod'.

results.title: Switching Eli to dev shows environment differences and dark mode
results.expected: In dev every flag is ON (Otherwise ON) and the dark-mode flag turns the store dark
notes: prod: light, classic home, all OFF. dev: data-theme=dark, new dashboard + beta report, all three flags ON 'no rule matched → Otherwise ON'.

results.title: Admin changes reach the storefront live without refreshing
results.expected: Add Eli (u_412) to rule 1 in the admin: the storefront switches within seconds, no reload
notes: Eli changed from classic home to 'Welcome back, Eli' 0.2 s after Save (live stream, no reload); debug 'matched rule 1 (user ID list)'.

results.title: SECTION-MCP
An editor MCP key cannot change production
results.expected: set_flag_enabled on prod returns isError "… may not change prod."; prod unchanged
notes: whoami role EDITOR, changeEnvironments [dev]; set_flag_enabled prod → isError: "key:qa-editor-agent (editor) may not change prod."; prod enabled still false.

results.title: A stale version causes a conflict rather than overwriting
results.expected: The second write with the old version is refused; the first write stands
notes: First write (version 0) accepted; second write with version 0: isError "'beta-reports' in dev changed since you loaded version 0 (now version 1). Reload and try again."; dev enabled stays false.

results.title: An admin MCP agent changes a prod rollout; audit shows key:<name>; storefront updates
results.expected: set_flag_rules 10% → 40% succeeds; audit "rollout 10% → 40%" by key:qa-admin-agent; Eli flips live
notes: set_flag_rules ok; Eli's storefront switched in 0.3 s with 'matched rule 3 (% rollout)'; get_audit_log latest = {summary: "rollout 10% → 40%", actor: "key:qa-admin-agent"}; same entry in Activity → Agents.
